# yatoi

A framework-neutral plugin kernel with reversible effects, typed capability discovery, cascade unload, and React and Vue bindings.

## Documentation

- [packages/kernel/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/kernel/README.md): Installation and first-use guide for @yatoi/kernel.
- [packages/kernel/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/kernel/AGENTS.md): Coding and review instructions for @yatoi/kernel.
- [packages/react/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/react/README.md): Installation and first-use guide for @yatoi/react.
- [packages/react/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/react/AGENTS.md): Coding and review instructions for @yatoi/react.
- [packages/slots/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/slots/README.md): Installation and first-use guide for @yatoi/slots.
- [packages/slots/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/slots/AGENTS.md): Coding and review instructions for @yatoi/slots.
- [packages/vue/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/vue/README.md): Installation and first-use guide for @yatoi/vue.
- [packages/vue/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/vue/AGENTS.md): Coding and review instructions for @yatoi/vue.
- [packages/react-slots/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/react-slots/README.md): Deprecated compatibility shim for @yatoi/react-slots.
- [packages/react-slots/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/react-slots/AGENTS.md): Migration instruction for the deprecated @yatoi/react-slots shim.
- [packages/vue-slots/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/vue-slots/README.md): Deprecated compatibility shim for @yatoi/vue-slots.
- [packages/vue-slots/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/packages/vue-slots/AGENTS.md): Migration instruction for the deprecated @yatoi/vue-slots shim.
- [docs/concepts.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/docs/concepts.md): Core vocabulary and the capability-graph mental model.
- [docs/guide.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/docs/guide.md): End-to-end usage patterns for plugins, services, collections, and bindings.
- [docs/pitfalls.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/docs/pitfalls.md): Known mistakes, failure modes, and safer alternatives.
- [docs/spec.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/docs/spec.md): Normative protocol semantics and conformance requirements.
- [docs/beyond-ui.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/docs/beyond-ui.md): How the kernel fits agent runtimes and long-running servers.
- [examples/todo/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/examples/todo/README.md): React todo application with installable UI plugins.
- [examples/todo-vue/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/examples/todo-vue/README.md): Vue port of the todo plugin application.
- [examples/agent-host/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/examples/agent-host/README.md): Node agent host with revocable tools and child-scoped delegation.
- [examples/server/README.md](https://github.com/yatoi-dev/yatoi-js/blob/main/examples/server/README.md): node:http host with capability-driven routes and jobs.
